statement: (n d : ℕ) (hd : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n) : Nat.Coprime d (n / d)
proof:
:= by
  have h_main : Nat.Coprime d (n / d) := by
    have h₁ : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n := hd
    have h₂ : d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n ∧ d ∣ n ∧ d.Coprime (n / d) := by
      simpa [properUnitaryDivisors] using h₁
    exact h₂.2.2
  exact h_main
